title: Product Designer
description:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

Imagine yourself in the 1970s or 80s thinking through how computing should look and feel for people who had never seen one before. That's what we're trying to do at Notion — make software that feels timeless, with the craftsmanship of German cameras, playfulness of Japanese toys, and mass appeal of Coca-Cola. We have no end of fascinating challenges that can only be solved by someone with innate product & UX sense, technical aptitude, great taste, and impeccable craft.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve



- Design product concepts that balance vision, craft, speed, and business potential.
- Craft every detail of new product features, from idea to UX to pixel-perfect execution.
- Run projects end to end with engineers to drive your vision to the ship line.
- Partner closely with our Customer Experience, Sales, and Customer Success teams to understand what each of our diverse user segments need, want, and love about Notion. Use this data and acquired intuition to prioritize, plan, and scope our product roadmap.
- Work with Marketing to devise new ways to tell great stories throughout the user lifecycle, and across our site, product, help guides and other channels.
- Create new patterns that are intuitive, practical, and convergent. Evolve our design system intentionally as we scale.

Skills You'll Need To Bring



- You have well-rounded skills and experience to run projects independently end to end. 5+ years of working experience.
- You seek to understand the needs of customers then explore and advocate for the strongest user experiences to solve their problems
- You enjoy untangling vague conceptual problems and have a sharp intuition for the most accessible mental models and flows, so users can immediately start gaining value out of the product.
- You create clear, intuitive, and visually appealing human interfaces

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
About Pantheon

Pantheon is the WebOps platform for websites that deliver extraordinary results. We believe in putting the magic of the internet in everyone's hands. That's why we're so passionate about helping developers, IT and marketing develop, test, and release website changes faster and more reliably so they can build and maintain websites that create value for their organizations. Our cloud native software makes it easy to securely manage a single website or thousands of websites across multiple teams in one platform.

Pantheon's core company values are Trust, Teamwork, Passion, and Customers First. At Pantheon, we work hard and play harder, valuing individuality, humor, and balance. We're enthusiastic participants in several open-source communities and have real relationships with many of our most active customers. If all of this sounds interesting to you, read on!

The Role

We're looking for a Staff Product Designer/Builder who combines design craft with product leadership. You'll define UX/UI strategy and lead product direction for an important part of Pantheon's product roadmap, working as a true product partner. This is a rare hybrid role: you'll design, build, lead, and drive product strategy from day one.

What You Need to Succeed



- Proficiency using AI tools to accelerate design workflows and increase velocity
- Strong hands-on product design skills with the ability to take products from concept through high-fidelity designs and implementation
- Demonstrated experience designing products that incorporate AI capabilities and intelligent features
- Ability to define the vision for product design within a software organization
- Expertise in overseeing the evolution of design systems, ensuring consistency and scalability across all products and platforms
- Deep expertise in conducting research to inform long-term product strategy and identify new software opportunities
- Ability to drive organizational change and process improvements to enhance design maturity
- Expertise in using success metrics to evaluate the impact of design solutions on user outcomes
- Ability to mentor designers and provide strategic input to product and engineering leadership
- Ability to articulate product strategy, design strategy, vision, and outcomes to senior leadership, product teams, and stakeholders
- Willingness to represent the company's design and product expertise at industry events and conferences

What You Bring to the Table



- Track record of using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Figma AI, generative design tools, LLM-assisted workflows) to accelerate building
- Experience in product and product design leadership, with a proven track record of defining and implementing successful UX strategies for SaaS products
- Familiarity with Claude Design and Claude code
- A strong desire to make an impact
- Experience codifying ambiguous problems and prioritizing how to build momentum in solving them
- Experience in new product development, including 0→1 prod

title: Lead Product Designer, Share
description:
About Ancestry

When you join Ancestry, you join a human-centered company where every person’s story is important. Ancestry®, the global leader in family history, connects everyone with their past so they can discover, preserve, and share their unique family stories. With our unparalleled collection of more than 65 billion records, over 3.5 million subscribers, and over 27 million people in our growing DNA network, customers can discover their family story and gain a new level of understanding about their lives. Over the past 40 years, we’ve built trusted relationships with millions of people who have chosen us as the platform for discovering, preserving, and sharing the most important information about themselves and their families.

We are committed to our location flexible work approach, allowing you to choose to work in the nearest office, from your home, or a hybrid of both (subject to location restrictions and roles that are required to be in the office- see the full list of eligible US locations HERE). We will continue to hire and promote beyond the boundaries of our office locations, to enable broadened possibilities for employee diversity.

Together, we work every day to foster a work environment that's inclusive as well as diverse, and where our people can be themselves. Every idea and perspective is valued so that our products and services reflect the global and diverse clients we serve.

Ancestry encourages applications from minorities, women, the disabled, protected veterans and all other qualified applicants. Passionate about dedicating your work to enriching people’s lives? Join the curious.

We’re looking for a Lead Product Designer to join our Preserve & Share team — a group dedicated to helping people save, celebrate, and share the moments and discoveries that matter most. This team is focused on family memory preservation and creating experiences that make it easy and rewarding for people to connect with loved ones, both within and beyond Ancestry.

This role will spearhead the company's strategy around 'Share,' the third pillar of our mission, aiming to help our users connect with family and friends over the discoveries they've made and preserved on Ancestry. You will own the long-term vision for the future of sharing, iterating on existing features while championing net-new strategies and capabilities to bring the value of 'sharing' to life. You’ll define experiences that transform discoveries into moments of profound connection, making family history more engaging and enduring—ultimately bringing families closer together.

You’ll report to the Design Director of the Preserve & Share team and collaborate closely with peers across product, design, engineering, research, content, and marketing. Together, you’ll create experiences that encourage people to preserve their stories and share them in ways that feel personal, meaningful, and delightful.

title: Product Designer
description:
About Sesame

Sesame believes in a future where computers are lifelike - with the ability to see, hear, and collaborate with us in ways that feel natural and human. With this vision, we're designing a new kind of computer, focused on making voice agents part of our daily lives. Our team brings together founders from Oculus and Ubiquity6, alongside proven leaders from Meta, Google, and Apple, with deep expertise spanning hardware and software. Join us in shaping a future where computers truly come alive.

About The Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Product Designer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be a creative problem-solver with a strong eye for design and a passion for creating user-centered products. You will lead design projects and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative and impactful design solutions.

Responsibilities



- Lead the design process from concept to final implementation, ensuring a high level of quality and consistency.
- Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to define project requirements and translate them into compelling design solutions.
- Create wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and detailed UI specifications to effectively communicate design ideas.
- Conduct user research and usability testing to gather insights and iterate on designs based on feedback.
- Ensure designs align with the overall product vision, user needs, and business goals.
- Foster a collaborative and growth-oriented design culture.
- Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies to continuously enhance design processes and deliverables.
- Advocate for user-centered design principles and contribute to the evolution of our design system and guidelines.

Required Qualifications



- Must have exceptional visual design skills, strong product thinking, solid prototyping skills and spike high in interaction design. 
- 7+ years of experience in product design, with a strong portfolio showcasing your expertise in web and mobile applications.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to present and articulate design decisions effectively.
- Experience conducting user research and usability testing.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and best practices.

Sesame is committed to a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome all qualified applicants, embracing diversity in race, gender, identity, orientation, ability, and more. We provide reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. Contact careers@sesame.com for assistance.

Full-time Employee Benefits



- 401 (k) max employer match: 3.5% of compensation
- 100% employer-paid health, vision, and dental benefits for you and your dependents
- Unlimited PTO and sick time
- Flexible spending account with employer

We are seeking a full-time Senior Product Designer to join the Device Interaction team at our headquarters in the greater Kansas City area. The Device Interaction team’s mission is to create superior apps and services that are an essential part of our customers' Garmin experience.

Garmin has a passionate, devoted group of customers that use our products to pursue their fitness and wellness goals. Our team has the privilege of helping these customers with seamless device interactions that just work.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will work primarily on Garmin Connect, the fitness and wellness application that millions of Garmin customers rely on. You will be expected to utilize your full range of user experience design, interaction design and visual design skills. A strong ability to collaborate with others is also a must. You’ll work closely with associates from various departments to research, prototype, design, present, and create highly usable interaction solutions.

If you’re passionate about creating the best user experience for web and mobile applications, we’re interested in discussing this opportunity with you. You’ll find more information about Garmin and what we do at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e0jAt_uuvQo

title: UI Design
description:
About Carvana

Carvana is a Fortune 500 Company growing at an unrivaled pace. We’re on a mission to change the way people buy, sell and trade cars. We're a tech-forward company that is innovating logistics networks, vehicle reconditioning processes, e-commerce and customer service. We believe in treating every customer with the same level of care and respect we would give our own moms.

We’re looking for people who are excited to thrive in an environment of impactful change. Team spirit is evident at Carvana and every day we let our passions and creativity foster innovation. We take big swings, set ambitious goals and challenge each other to make data and process-driven decisions in everything we do. Here are a few of our stories. We’ve been changing the game since 2013, and we’re not taking our foot off the gas now.

THIS IS A 100% ON-SITE POSITION in Los Angeles, California (Monday through Friday)

Role Overview

As a UI Designer at Carvana, you are responsible for elevating the craft, clarity, and consistency of our digital experiences. You translate defined product requirements and interaction concepts into polished, scalable, system-aligned interfaces.

You play a key role in setting and maintaining the quality of our global Carvana design standards across multiple product orgs and surfaces, ensuring consistency, accessibility, and visual excellence throughout the ecosystem.

Partnering closely with Product Designers, Product Managers, and Engineering, you bring strong visual judgment and systems fluency to ensure experiences are cohesive, production-ready, and aligned to our design system standards.

What You’ll Be Doing



- Design high-quality UI for initiatives of all sizes across web and mobile experiences
- Translate product requirements and interaction flows into polished, production-ready interfaces
- Apply and extend the design system to ensure consistency and scalability
- Ensure layouts, typography, spacing, and visual hierarchy meet system and accessibility standards
- Leverage a deep understanding of UX principles to thoughtfully extend UI patterns while preserving usability and system integrity
- Create high-fidelity mock-ups, interactive prototypes, and clear design documentation
- Partner closely with other Product Designers to refine flows and ensure strong UI expression
- Collaborate with Engineering to support implementation accuracy and resolve UI edge cases
- Identify UI inconsistencies and propose improvements to patterns and components
- Contribute to evolving our design system through component enhancements and documentation
- Maintain precision and detail throughout execution, including states, responsiveness, and accessibility considerations

What You Should Have



- 3–5+ years of experience in Product Design or UI
- Demonstrated ability to lead projects independently with consistent quality
- Deep understanding of layout, typography, color, spacing, and visual hierarchy
- Strong foundation in user-centered design,

description:
About Adaptive

NVIDIA and OpenAI’s only AI cybersecurity investment.

Adaptive is a cybersecurity startup on a mission to stop AI-powered cyberattacks. In December 2025, the company announced an $81M Series B led by NVIDIA and Bain Capital Ventures, with participation from Capital One Ventures, Citi Ventures, and continued support from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), the OpenAI Startup Fund, and Abstract Ventures. The round marked NVIDIA’s first AI cybersecurity investment.

Adaptive was founded by Brian Long and Andrew Jones, repeat entrepreneurs who have built and scaled category-defining companies. title: User Experience Designer
description:
UX Designer - Hybrid, Cary, North Carolina

We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence - and questions into answers.

If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.

About The Job

The Core UI design team within the R&D Foundation Division is looking for a UX Designer to help shape the shared application experiences that power SAS platforms and applications. These experiences form the backbone of how users navigate, manage, and interact with SAS solutions—supporting onboarding, system administration, and cross-application workflows.

You will play a key role in designing cohesive, scalable experiences across shared applications such as system management, data access, and content workflows. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of complex problem spaces and help guide design direction across teams.

You’ll collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Design partners to bring clarity, consistency, and usability to foundational platform experiences.

As a UX Designer, You Will

- Help define and scale reusable patterns and interaction models that support consistency across SAS products 
- Partner with cross-functional teams to align on priorities, refine requirements, and ensure high-quality delivery 
- Conduct and apply user research, usability testing, and feedback to inform design decisions 
- Contribute to and leverage the SAS Filament Design System to ensure scalable, consistent design solutions 
- Collaborate with accessibility experts to ensure inclusive and usable experiences 
- Collaborate with engineering teams on React-based front-end applications 
- Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.

- Bachelor’s degree in User Experience (UX), Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interactive Design, Graphic Design, Industrial Design, or a related field

- Strong interaction design skills across multi-step workflows and cross-product experiences

Work & Co, part of Accenture Song, is a global design and technology company with offices in the United States, Europe, and Latin America. We're known for uniting the industry’s best hands-on strategy, product and technical talent to generate tangible impact at scale. Client partners include IKEA, Apple, PGA TOUR, Gatorade, Google, Mercedes, Givenchy, the MTA and more. As Fast Company noted, our engineering and design teams are routinely entrusted with creating digital products for companies which rarely approach outside firms. Forrester Research calls our approach “a model to follow.” Visit work.co to learn more.

- Participate in all project phases, from strategy to launch to optimization

description:
ROLE Senior Product Designer

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer with a passion for finding solutions that allow customers to intuitively use our products. The ideal candidate will be skilled at each stage of the design process but always focused on the needs of the customer.

You will work with other designers and cross-functional team members and will rely heavily on both qualitative and quantitative data to make informed decisions.

Join us at Reevo Inc., where our initial focus on enhancing workflows for Account Executives (AE) and Sales Development Representatives (SDR) has laid the foundation for our ambitious goal to build an end-to-end solution designed to replace the existing sales tech stack. This is your opportunity to be a pivotal part of a dynamic team set out to redefine sales.

LOCATION On-site, Santa Clara / Remote

About Reevo

Reevo is a fast-growing startup at the forefront of AI-driven sales and revenue operations. Our mission is to simplify complex processes for mid-market and SMBs, enabling them to scale efficiently through intelligent, integrated platforms.

The sales platforms software market is projected to grow from $72 billion in 2022 to $193 billion in 2032, driven by the demand for digital sales tools. Out of the total sales tech market, CRM makes up $46 billion.

However, Sales orgs have bloated tech stacks ranging from 10 (sales org of ~25 people) to 20+ (sales org of ~250 people) different point solutions. Companies are looking to significantly simplify their tech stack and have it work for them instead of the other way around. Every sales tool claims to create an all-in-one revenue platform, but nobody is fulfilling that promise.

This tech stack is costly and hinders sales productivity:



- Productivity lost - when reps update CRM, it takes 2-4 hours / week through the help of UX tools
- Revenue lost - CRM data is “garbage in, garbage out” and CRM’s data visualization / drill-down capabilities are very poor. Visibility into what’s working and what’s not is very low. This means no predictive or real-time insights to guide executives in decision-making. 
- Software cost - adding tools that marginally helps sales team productivity
- Headcount cost - hiring Sales / Revenue Ops teams just to wrangle the tech stack and surface insights

Reevo’s vision: revolutionize sales by delivering revenue in a box:



- All activities happen in an AI-native operating platform with features that help teams sell
- Unified data layer that’s context-rich
- Form insights for coaching sales teams and making better strategic decisions

WHO YOU ARE:

You thrive in fast-paced environments. At this stage we’re still learning. You will wear the product hat along with engineers and business stakeholders on the founding team to focus on high impact work.

You can work through ambiguity. Your experience will enable you to focus on the elements that matter most and drive clear insights that inform the team’s priorities.

description:
Chronic disease isn't managed in a clinic. It is managed at home, in relationships, in the everyday. What's on the dinner table, what gets said, and who notices when someone's struggling. For the 130 million Americans managing a chronic condition, the healthcare system has offered the same answer for decades: a 15-minute doctor's visit, a pamphlet, and a portal login they'll never use.

At Nuna, we are building an AI health coach that shows up like a person who actually has time: available at 3am, infinitely patient, and never behind a waiting room. We use motivational interviewing to help patients and their families see themselves clearly, design experiments that fit their real lives, and navigate a system that has not historically been on their side. We are building from the ground up around a simple belief: patients don't want to be healthy; they want their lives back.

We're not competing with other health apps. We're competing with the moment a person gives up on getting better. If that's a problem you want to work on, we'd like to talk.

Your team

Our products are only as good as the care and science behind them. We are a small team of engineers, designers, product managers, and clinicians who work together to build for both patients and providers.

You will be expected to own real pieces of the product from day one and be responsible for building, shipping, and supporting them in production.

Design sets the bar for the character, tone, and visual impact of our products and is responsible for designing experiences that are intuitive and compelling to use. Nuna Designers embrace their superpower to visualize the ideal user experience, rapidly testing and iterating on solutions while aligning the teams on a common vision.

This is a highly visible role across the organization, requiring extensive cross-functional collaboration and engagement. It also necessitates deep empathy for and understanding of patient healthcare and wellness journeys; the primary focus of our work. This is an opportunity to play a critical part in conceptualizing and launching Nuna’s patient and provider experiences

title: Product Designer
description:
About Authorium

Authorium is the governed front door for government documents. Every consequential thing a government does starts as a document, whether a scope of work, a minimum needs statement, a bill analysis, a project charter, and it has to become governed, structured action: an approval, a procurement, a contract, a grant. We start with the document, connect it to a governed AI layer, and let it accrue the actions that turn it into a workflow.

We’re investing in AI capabilities — both internally and externally — building workflows specifically for government operations, and building an AI-first operational culture to accelerate our work and go further. AI isn't a side project here - it's reshaping both what we build and how we build it.

What a Designer is at Authorium

You take an idea from a rough concept to a polished, production interface running in front of real government users, and you work highly independently through that process with a clear feedback loop.

You'll lean heavily on AI-native tooling to compress that loop. We expect you to be genuinely fluent in Claude Design and comparable AI design/build tools by using them to go from prompt to prototype. The candidates we're most excited about treat AI as a force multiplier on craft, not a replacement for it.

Why This Role Exists

Government workflows are complex by nature. Our users manage procurement solicitations, evaluation scoring, contract documents, and compliance reporting and often for the first time on a digital platform. Making dense, high-stakes workflows feel navigable for people who didn't choose the tool and can't easily change their process is our baseline challenge - and an Authorium Design Engineer relishes that challenge and has a desire to live on both the design and engineering side of delivery.

What You'll Do

Design and build, end to end



- Take features from concept through interaction design, prototyping, and have a desire to front-end implementation.
- Build and maintain real interfaces in our codebase (Hotwire / Next.js), partnering with Engineering on architecture, state, and performance.
- Use Claude Design and other AI tooling to move fast: rapid prototypes, multiple directions, working components and bring strong judgment about which output is actually good.

Shape the product surface



- Improve UX across the platform from intake, approvals, document generation, evaluations, configuration, and reporting including fixing inconsistencies and usability gaps as you go.
- Contribute to the design system: components, patterns, and libraries that keep the product coherent and speed up everyone's delivery. You'll both use it and extend it in code.
- Help shape how AI shows up in the product with making AuthorAI feel context-aware and trustworthy for users across every level of AI comfort.

Ship with quality



- Design and build for accessibility and compliance from the start (WCAG 2.1 AA) — our government customers require it.

This role is ideal for a designer ready to lead feature-level design work, drive UX improvements proactively, and operate with a high degree of ownership.

What will you do?



- Design end-to-end experiences, from discovery to user flows, wireframes, and production-quality UI in Figma.

- You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.

- You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure

title: Product Designer - New Vertical
description:
About Basis

Basis builds real agents that do real work in the real economy. Our agents operate for hours at a time, performing end-to-end work for some of the largest accounting firms in the world.

We recently raised $100M at >$1B valuation and are racing to deploy the most advanced applied ML at production scale.

Our investors include: Khosla Ventures (Keith Rabois & Vinod Khosla), Accel (Miles Clements), Google Ventures, Nat Friedman & Daniel Gross, Adam D'Angelo, Jeff Dean, Jack Altman, Noam Brown, Kyle Vogt, Amjad Masad, Clem Delangue and many other operators/technical leaders.

"Basis is on the frontier of building production-grade, long-horizon agents. They've pushed the limits of what we thought our models could do on real-world, economically valuable, complex accounting tasks. They've been a great collaborator in helping us shape what the future of agents looks like." — Prashant Mital, Applied AI Lead, OpenAI

Modern AI lets software reason in real time. That overturns decades of UX assumptions. A chatbot bolted onto old workflows won’t cut it; we need interfaces where humans and agents co-create work, hand tasks back and forth, and build trust in real time.

You will lead Basis into that design unknown: design both the screens accountants see and the invisible UI “toolbox” agents draw from when they assemble those screens.

Imagine Basis 18 months out, then ship toward it one release at a time.

📍 Location: NYC, Flatiron office. In-person team.

- Build

- Partner closely with product design on working agents seamlessly into new and existing products
- Be a visionary: Pair with founders to sketch Basis 2027, then distill it into quarterly bets
- Understand our many accounting users: Building really good systems here start from deep user empathy. You will spend a portion of your time actually doing accounting work in Basis and becoming a user
- Learn at warp speed: Immerse in what makes accounting awesome, emergent abilities of LLMs, and various UX for generally-intelligent software, then turn that insight into product decisions
- Learning velocity: New domains (hello, accounting!) and new tech click for you in weeks, not months.
What You'll Bring



- Experience: 4–8 years designing complex SaaS or AI tooling, with at least one 0→1 launch (extraordinary talent with fewer years considered).
- First-principles reasoner: You break problems to fundamentals and rebuild without legacy bias.
- Agent-native builder: You already prototype with LLMs and can explain why they change UX.
- Use AI a lot: You should be using AI for your own work a ton. To learn, brainstorm, write, research etc.

title: Product Designer

Our mission is to transform global finance by empowering professionals at the world's top investment banks, private equity funds, and investment firms with AI that delivers unparalleled speed, accuracy, and insight. We're not just improving financial workflows; we're redefining them.

This is a unique opportunity to join a generational company driving transformation in one of the most important industries in the world. Our team is sharp, motivated, and deeply committed to Rogo’s mission. We take ownership of complex problems and stay relentlessly focused on our users. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, demand excellence, and want to help build the future of finance, we invite you to join us.

Why Design Matters for the Future of Finance

title: Product Designer
description:
About Treeswift

In the face of rising threats like severe storms and wildfires, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demands for system expansion, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead.

To accomplish our mission we deploy our sensors into our customers' field operations, typically on backpacks or vehicles. The resulting trove of LiDAR and imagery data is processed through our AI models to deliver actionable analytics through our web platform. To date, our technology has enabled utilities to reduce wildfire, regulatory and outage risk from vegetation, avoid delays and cost overruns in new construction, and accelerate recovery from severe storms.

After starting our work with utilities in June 2024, we are now working with 3 of the 5 largest utilities in the United States and are rapidly expanding across new customers and use cases. To tackle this challenge we are bringing together a team of mission-driven experts with deep industry experience in robotics (Penn, Caltech, CMU) and enterprise software development (Palantir, Stripe, Oracle, MongoDB). We have raised funding from leading investors including Penny Pritzker's Inspired Capital.

Treeswift is headquartered in lower Manhattan, and maintains an office in Philadelphia. We also have some customer-facing team members based closer to our customer sites (i.e. Bay Area).

We hope you join us on this journey!

About The Role

You will be Treeswift’s first full-time design hire joining at a pivotal moment: our product is used by some of the largest utilities in the country, and we are scaling from our work with early partners to become the broader platform for modern utility field operations.

This is a rare opportunity to define how design informs our product and organization from the ground up. You will own end-to-end product design across our web platform and hardware physical interfaces, shaping how customers interact with complex geospatial, imagery, and LiDAR data, and establish the design systems and product patterns that allow us to scale across customers, use cases, and teams.

You will be deeply hands-on in the early days, talking to users, mapping workflows, prototyping, designing core product experiences, and partnering closely with product and engineering to ship. You will set the tone for larger design organization: setting the bar for craft, developing repeatable design processes, and influencing the product strategy behind a new category of software and hardware for utilities.

This role is ideal for someone who wants significant ownership, comfortable with high ambiguity, and the chance to build the design function for a mission-driven company from its earliest stages.

What You’ll Do



- Own end-to-end product design. Contribute to design across Treeswift’s core platform, from discovery and workflow mapping through polished designs, prototypes, implementation details, and post-launch iteration.

title: Product Designer
description:
About The Role

We're looking for a product designer who wants to operate like a founder.

Not someone who waits for tickets or perfect requirements. Someone who sees opportunities, prototypes fast, shapes product direction, and ships experiences that move the company forward.

This is not a "make the UI pretty" role. You'll work across product thinking, interaction design, systems, prototyping, and execution. In many cases, you'll go from idea → prototype → shipped product in days, not quarters.

The best people for this role think strategically, build relentlessly, and use AI as leverage.

Why This Role Is Different

The role of design is changing.

AI has collapsed the distance between idea and execution. The best designers today don't just create mockups, they can explore product directions, prototype interactions, generate working interfaces, and pressure-test ideas themselves.

We Believe The Future Belongs To Designers Who



- Think like product leaders
- Prototype like engineers
- Use AI tools fluently
- Care about outcomes, not deliverables
- Move from ambiguity to shipped product with very little overhead

If that excites you, you'll probably love working here.

What You'll Work On



- Own product areas end-to-end, from initial insight to shipped experience
- Lead greenfield explorations and turn blank-canvas ideas into real products
- Prototype aggressively, in code, AI tools, Figma, or whatever gets the idea across fastest
- Work directly with engineers and PMs to shape product direction, not just execution
- Think deeply about systems, workflows, and how features compound across the platform
- Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow to increase speed, creativity, and iteration velocity
- Raise the quality bar across the company through strong product judgment and craft
- Push ideas into reality quickly instead of over-optimizing in planning phases

- We optimize for speed of learning and iteration
- We prototype early instead of debating endlessly
- We use AI heavily across design, product thinking, research, and engineering
- We believe small, high-agency teams can outperform much larger organizations
- We believe the best builders in the AI era are token maxxers, people who use AI relentlessly to compress execution cycles, test ideas faster, and expand the scope of what a single person can accomplish
- We care more about shipping and learning than rigid role boundaries

What We're Looking For



- 3–6 years of product design experience, ideally at startups or highly product-driven teams
- A strong track record of owning products or features from concept through launch

- Strong product instincts and clear opinions about what should exist and why

About Revin

At Revin, our mission is to bring superintelligence to the built world. Millions of operators across Home Services, Construction, and Remodeling have been overlooked by the last wave of technology. We believe AI is the most transformational platform change in history, but the hard work lies in thoughtful, context-aware applications of this technology to the real world.

Revin provides operators with an end-to-end system of intelligence to automate and scale revenue. Our modular suite of products includes Scheduling, Appointment Management, Membership Management, Inside Sales, Revenue Capture, Marketing, and Funnel Optimization.

Today, over $3B in revenue runs on Revin, making us the number one AI partner for enterprise operators. Our customers include Sears Home Services ($800M), Astara Capital ($700M), Del Air ($150M), Long Home Remodeling ($150M), ImproveIt Remodeling ($100M), Sage Home ($80M), and more. We have raised $10M from top investors including Stellation Capital, 1Sharpe, Gokul Rajaram, Russ Heddleston, Michael Werner, Tandem, Max Branzburg, and Marc Bhargava.

We are hiring our first in-house Senior Product Designer to own product design end-to-end: the dashboard where operators configure, monitor, and trust AI agents that handle revenue-critical conversations over SMS, voice, and email. This is a founding role: you will set the design foundation the rest of the company builds on, and work AI-natively to get there.

Why This Role

The honest pitch: we are handing the entire design surface of the company to one person, right before it gets much bigger.

The dashboard is yours. The design system is yours. The patterns that decide whether an operator trusts an AI agent with their revenue, yours. How Revin looks and feels in the market, yours. You will not be handed a style guide and a backlog. You will decide what good looks like here and then build it.

This is our first in-house design hire, and the ceiling is the design function itself. Do this well and you grow into leading design as we scale the team.

title: Product Design Lead [33261]
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY
The company operates at the frontier of predictive intelligence, using AI to simulate and predict human behavior at scale. By generating and deploying instances of artificial intelligence that mirror humans, called agents, it simulates entire populations with unprecedented accuracy. Partners leverage the platform to refine strategy in volatile geopolitical climates, cut new product innovation timelines from months to minutes, and deploy marketing campaigns that win in an era where consumers have never been harder to understand. The platform provides organizations with invaluable foresight, empowering them to anticipate outcomes and proactively make the right decisions at the right time.
The team is small, dedicated, and mission-driven. The belief is that the best work happens when exceptionally talented people are given ownership, trust, and the space to operate without bureaucratic friction. The company works with urgency and intellectual honesty and expects team members to match that velocity. It seeks individuals who thrive at the frontier, push beyond conventional limits, bring curiosity and conviction in equal measure, and want their work to have demonstrable impact. If you're energized by the idea of a small team doing things that feel impossible, this could be the right place for you.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As a member of the Product Design team, you'll help users make decisions faster. The Product Design team owns designing, building, and evolving user experiences across every surface of the platform. You'll design experiences for personas across the technical spectrum and synthesize cutting-edge research into features used daily by executives and developers alike.
RESPONSIBILITIES

- Identify patterns across user needs and product opportunities to 10x the impact of the simulation software
- Ship fast while advancing the platform design system
- Force-multiply engineering through high-quality prototypes using agentic workflows
- Experiment with and advance AI-native design workflows
- Help hire designers who raise the bar
YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

- You've released your own products or led product design initiatives previously
- You thrive in ambiguous and novel technical domains
- You value feedback more than conformity
- You can defend your choices and clearly explain your reasoning
- You use AI tools heavily, but your taste isn't outsourced to them
- You ship quickly and know when to slow down for polish
- You communicate clearly in writing and in person
- You have the courage to push back and the humility to change your mind
STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO

- Have built a design system for a platform or developer product
- Have shipped 0→1 product surfaces, not just iterations on existing products
- Have contributed to open-source or production codebases
LOCATION
This role is based in New York City. The company operates in-person, working five days a week from the office. Candidates should be located within the New York City metropol

We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects. 
 Position Overview
We’re building the command layer for a new generation of intelligent robots.
As our first UX/UI design hire, you will define how humans command, deploy, and collaborate with autonomous systems in the physical world. You will own the experience for fleet command of distributed, sensor-equipped robotic systems operating in real environments. This is mission-critical software that enables non-experts to operate intelligent machines, not a fleet dashboard with status icons. Customers will rely on what you design to monitor, deploy, coordinate, and intervene across their robot installations. 
Beyond fleet command, you will architect a radically simplified deployment experience: a true “unbox, power on, connect, deploy” journey via app or tablet. Our ambition is to eliminate heavy pilots and prolonged engagements by making robot activation intuitive, guided, and production-ready from day one.
This is a zero-to-one role with expanding scope. You will set the design standard for the company and establish deployment and command UX as a strategic advantage for Skild AI.Responsibilities

- Own UX/UI from concept through production.
- Translate complex robotics and AI capabilities into simplified, controllable systems.
- Design production workflows for distributed, moving, sensor-equipped assets.
- Lead customer interviews, usability studies, and rapidly prototyping.
- Raise the design craft, rigor, and systems-thinking bar across the applied AI team.
- End-to-end UX for fleet monitoring and control
- AI-assisted control surfaces (configure, automate, supervise, escalate)
- Self-service onboarding and training workflows
- Real-time telemetry and multimodal sensor visualization (camera + beyond)
- Alerting, incident response, and system health management
- Task orchestration and multi-robot coordinationPreferred Qualifications

- 2-4 years designing exceptional consumer hardware experiences and/or complex B2B operational systems.
- Proven experience building production workflows for distributed systems or moving assets.
- Strong background in data-heavy, real-time operational tools.
- Experience with monitoring, alerting, and multi-state workflows.
- Experience designing interfaces integrating multimodal data.
- Demonstrated systems thinking and high design craft.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

At Circle, we are moving from a phase of rapid expansion to one of sophisticated scale. As we grow, the foundational systems that power our products need to mature.

We are looking for a Lead Product Designer to join our Identity Team. This is a horizontal platform role, meaning you won’t just be building features for one user type; you will be architecting the "front door" of Circle. You will design the systems—like Authentication, Roles & Permissions, and Billing—that every other product team at Circle will rely on.

We need a builder who loves logic, systems, and consistency, but who refuses to compromise on beauty. We are looking for someone with a strong background in Visual and UI design who can bring a level of polish and craft that sets the standard for the rest of the organization.

What You'll Work On

Transforming Chaos into Order: Circle is transforming from a startup to a mature tech organization. You will audit existing, fragmented workflows and unify them into a cohesive platform experience.

Unified Identity: You will design how users experience Roles, Permissions, and Team Management, taking complex logic and making it intuitive for admins and end-users alike.

Centralized Billing Infrastructure: You will design a scalable billing and subscription experience that unifies how customers pay for different parts of the Circle ecosystem.

Security meets UX: You will tackle high-stakes flows like Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), SSO setup, and account recovery, ensuring that security never comes at the expense of usability.

title: Interaction Designer, AI Foundations
description:
In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:



- Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
- Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
- Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
- Sick Time: 40 hours/year (statutory, where applicable); 5 days/event (discretionary)
- Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
- Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
- Holidays: 13 paid days per year.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: San José, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; Seattle, WA, USA.Minimum qualifications:



- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 4 years of interaction design experience in product design or UX design.
- Include a portfolio, website, or any other relevant link to your work in your resume (providing a viewable link or access instructions).

Preferred qualifications:



- Master's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 2 years of experience working in a complex, cross-functional organization.
- 1 year of experience leading design projects.
- Experience designing enterprise products or highly complex consumer products.
- Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams of Designers, Researchers, Engineers, and Product Managers throughout the design process.
- Experience designing across multiple platforms, and working with technical/design teams to create user flows, wireframes, and building user interface mockups and prototypes.

About The Job

At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Our Interaction Designers transform complex tasks into intuitive, easy-to-use experiences for billions of people. From creating user flows and wireframes to building mockups and prototypes, you will envision and bring product experiences to life with an inspired, refined, and magical feel. You will join our multi-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, leveraging user insights to create industry-leading products.

As an Interaction Designer, you'll apply user-centered design methods to craft industry-leading user experiences from concept to execution, working with design partners to evolve the Google design language to build beautiful, innovative products.

When you think of “big data,” Google is at the forefront of companies that push the envelope, developing systems that handle exabytes of data distributed across the planet. To enable Google developers and product areas to manage this data at scale, Google creates and maintains an entire ecosystem of infrastructure and tooling, much of which falls under the umbrella of AI Foundations. About Us

Gumloop is the piece of AI infrastructure companies roll out to let everyone build agents securely. Let people who understand the problem build and share agents, manage their access to data, choose your AI models and host it all in your own cloud.

We're a very small team building as fast as humanly possible. Gusto, Ramp, Shopify, Samsara, Instacart, and Opendoor are running agents on Gumloop across their company. We've raised over $70M from Benchmark, First Round Capital, Y Combinator, Nexus Ventures to scale operations and are looking for people who care as much as we do to join the team.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Product Design Engineer to help shape, design, and build high-craft product experiences end to end. This role sits at the intersection of product, design, and engineering. You’ll own key user-facing surfaces from early concept through final implementation, using strong product judgment, thoughtful interaction design, and excellent frontend execution to make complex workflows feel simple.

The ideal candidate is comfortable operating with high ownership. You should be able to take a product problem, reason through the UX, design the interface, build the frontend, and collaborate with engineering when backend support is needed. You’ll also help evolve our design system and establish reusable patterns that make the product better over time, and allow the rest of our engineering team to build beautiful interfaces.

This is a high-impact role for someone who wants direct influence over what we build, how it works, and how it feels.

What You’ll Do



- Design and build polished, user-facing product experiences across core surfaces of the product. 
- Own features end to end, from product thinking and UX exploration through implementation and iteration. 
- Use layout, interaction design, and motion to make powerful workflows feel intuitive and fast. 
- Contribute to and evolve our design system, component library, and frontend patterns. 
- Work closely with product, design, and engineering to turn ambiguous ideas into simple, high-quality experiences. 
- Bring strong craft to the details: accessibility, performance, reliability, responsive behavior, and edge cases. 
- Partner with other engineers, and when needed contribute across the stack to bring features fully across the finish line. 

What You Bring



- 2–5+ years of experience building user-facing products in high-ownership environments. 
- Strong experience with TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, and modern frontend development. 
- Experience contributing to or building a design system, component library, or reusable frontend patterns.

description:

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.

AI at SharkNinja 

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. At SharkNinja, we are building an AI-native culture. We don’t just use AI as an afterthought—we are actively re-engineering how consumer products are invented, prototyped, and brought to market. We are seeking a visionary AI Designer to sit at the intersection of front-end product innovation, generative design, and operational automation.

- Accelerate Front-End Innovation: Partner with industrial design and product engineering teams to use Generative AI systems (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Vizcom, etc.) for rapid 2D/3D concept generation and product visualization. 
- Engineer Intelligent Workflows: Design, test, and deploy customized AI prompts, agents, and custom GPT environments to automate and optimize repetitive creative and operational processes. 
- Democratize AI Literacy: Act as an internal evangelist. Create frameworks, playbooks, and training sessions to help cross-functional teams (from R&D to Product Marketing) integrate advanced AI assistants seamlessly into their daily tasks. 
- Bridge Physical and Digital Design: Collaborate with UI/UX and mobile app teams to explore how consumer-facing AI experiences can enhance our physical hardware ecosystems (smart home, connected kitchen, etc.). 
- Evaluate Emerging Tech: Continuously source, stress-test, and onboard emerging foundational models, plugins, and software to ensure SharkNinja remains at the absolute bleeding edge of design automation. 

Qualifications



- 3+ Years in Design / Product Dev

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:



- SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform. 
- SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair. 
- SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective. 

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:



- Committed to our customers and community. 
- Obsessed with quality.

description:
The Role

Linktree is evolving from a link-in-bio tool to the place creators and businesses run everything — a control center that helps them understand what's working across platforms and decide what to do next. Linktree's users live on their phones, and native mobile is where a huge amount of that value gets delivered: capturing content on the go, staying on top of their audience, getting coached in the moment on how to grow. We're raising our mobile bar across the whole product, and we need a Staff designer to lead that craft.

Why This Role Matters

This is our mobile craft anchor. Every experience pillar owns its own mobile and web surfaces — your job is to be the designer who sets and raises the native bar across all of them. It's a cross-pillar, influence-heavy role: you'll go deep where native truly wins and keep the app feeling like one coherent product, not five disconnected ones — so every pillar's mobile work gets better.

- Set and continually raise the bar for native iOS and Android across the entire product.

- Lead through influence — lifting the mobile craft of designers across every pillar.

- An obsession with deep native mobile craft — fluency with iOS and Android conventions, gestures, motion, and performance-aware design.
- Significant time shipping consumer mobile products at scale, across diverse user bases where you've learned to balance sophistication with everyday usability — with a portfolio that reflects it.
- Staff-level scope: you set direction and raise the bar around you, not just ship your own screens.
- Low ego, high collaboration — your craft serves the product. You partner with the pillar design leads rather than competing with them, and you're energized by raising the mobile craft bar across teams, not by owning product direction yourself.
- Systems thinking — you design patterns that scale across surfaces and teams.
- Influence without authority — you make other teams better without managing them.
- AI as part of how you work (a baseline for us), with the depth to push our practice forward.
- Sharp product judgment; empathy for creators and the creator economy is a plus.

Your depth — and your range

Mobile is your depth, and we want someone genuinely great at it. But the strongest mobile designers are strong product designers first — so we're looking for range too: the judgment to frame problems, the taste to know what's worth building, and the ability to work beyond native when the problem calls for it.

title: UX/UI Engineer
description:
About Us

We are a small early-stage (pre-Series A) startup building AI-powered software for clinical research teams at academic medical centers. We turn dense, unstructured trial protocols into structured, usable data, so the people running studies spend less time wrangling documents and more time on the work that matters.

The Role

We need someone who can sit between dense, technical clinical-trial workflows and the people who use them every day, and make the complicated feel obvious. High autonomy, high ownership, low process. You will have real influence over the product, not a backlog of pixel-pushing tickets.

Why this role exists

We build software for clinical research teams at academic medical centers. The problems we solve are genuinely hard: turning long, unstructured protocol documents into structured data and usable interfaces that coordinators rely on for high-stakes, detail-heavy work.

Our team is strong on the systems side. We think logically, algorithmically, and we build robust pipelines and data models. What we are missing is a design-first voice: someone whose instinct is to start with the user, question complexity, and relentlessly simplify. You would own that perspective and raise the bar for the entire product experience.

This is not a "take the spec and build the screens" role. You will help decide what the screens should be.

What You'll Do



- Own the end-to-end experience for key workflows, from problem framing and user research through interaction design, prototyping, and shipped front-end code.
- Turn complex, information-dense tasks into clear, low-friction interfaces. Reduce clicks, cognitive load, and the chance of error for expert users doing repetitive, high-stakes work.
- Translate real user behavior into design decisions. Talk to users, watch them work, and bring that evidence back to the team.
- Build production UI for our application in React, and maintain a coherent, reusable component system.
- Design and build our public-facing website, owning how we present the product to the world.
- Establish and grow our design system: tokens, components, patterns, and the documentation that keeps them consistent.
- Be the advocate for the user in a room full of engineers who naturally think in systems and edge cases. Push back, propose alternatives, and explain the "why" behind design choices.
- Partner closely with backend and platform engineers so the experience and the data model serve each other.

Who You Are



- You start from the user, not the feature list. When you see complexity, your first question is whether the user should ever have to see it.
- You hold both craft and pragmatism: you care about typography, spacing, and interaction detail, and you also ship.
- You can design and build. You move fluidly between Figma and a code editor and do not need a separate engineer to make your designs real.
- You communicate design decisions clearly to a technical audience and welcome being challenged on them.
